result.counting: global release IDs; catches exclude initial airborne ball unless explicitly noted

conditions.observation: Sampled position estimates for live reception; truth for contact, safety and rollouts

ball_observation.scope: current task decisions and reception prediction
ball_observation.release_history: positions sampled after last measured hand contact
ball_observation.support_input: hand contact and palm proprioception; no ball velocity

complete_task.start: two balls right, one left; no initially airborne ball
complete_task.ball_collision_policy: reset pair 0/2 only before confirmed first release, retained ball touching right hand and both centers within the support radius; no post-release exemption
complete_task.control: pure contact; ending prediction uses the selected ball observation mode

task_decisions.low_level_contact_input: classical controller simulator contact and ball state

execution.scope: live steps only; hinge joint actuators; excludes passive and constraint forces
execution.near_limit_definition: within 1% of configured actuator force range

observation_source: sampled positions and causal estimates; robot proprioception and tactile forces
